{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, wait)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.Aeson (FromJSON, ToJSON, decode, encode)
import Data.ByteString.Lazy qualified as LBS
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as BS
import Data.Char (ord, chr)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Text qualified as T
import Data.Text.Encoding qualified as TE
import Data.Word (Word8)
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp

data UserProfile = UserProfile
  { displayName :: Text
  , locale :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON UserProfile
instance ToJSON UserProfile

type SessionStore = MVar (Map.Map Text UserProfile)

-- | Normalize header value by collapsing whitespace sequences
normalizeHeaderValue :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
normalizeHeaderValue = collapseSpaces . BS.strip
  where
    collapseSpaces bs
      | BS.null bs = bs
      | otherwise = 
          let (prefix, rest) = BS.break isLinearWS bs
              (spaces, suffix) = BS.span isLinearWS rest
          in if BS.null spaces
             then prefix
             else prefix <> BS.singleton 0x20 <> collapseSpaces suffix
    isLinearWS w = w == 0x20 || w == 0x09

-- | Encode text for use in HTTP header values.
-- This uses RFC 5987 encoding for non-ASCII characters
-- and strips control characters from the ASCII range.
encodeForHeader :: Text -> BS.ByteString
encodeForHeader t = 
  let encoded = TE.encodeUtf8 t
      filtered = BS.filter (\w -> w >= 0x20 && w /= 0x7F) encoded
  in filtered

-- | Build a content-disposition header for file downloads
-- with the user's display name as part of the filename
buildContentDisposition :: Text -> Text -> BS.ByteString
buildContentDisposition username fileType =
  let safeName = encodeForHeader username
      header = BS.concat
        [ "attachment; filename=\""
        , safeName
        , "_report."
        , TE.encodeUtf8 fileType
        , "\""
        ]
  in normalizeHeaderValue header

-- | Async task that fetches user profile and builds response headers
buildResponseHeaders :: SessionStore -> Text -> IO ResponseHeaders
buildResponseHeaders store sessionId = do
  sessions <- readMVar store
  case Map.lookup sessionId sessions of
    Nothing -> return [(hContentType, "text/plain")]
    Just profile -> do
      -- Simulate async profile enrichment from external service
      enrichTask <- async $ enrichProfile profile
      enriched <- wait enrichTask
      let localeHeader = buildLocaleHeader (locale enriched)
      let disposition = buildContentDisposition (displayName enriched) "pdf"
      return
        [ (hContentType, "application/pdf")
        , ("Content-Disposition", disposition)
        , ("X-User-Locale", localeHeader)
        ]

-- | Build locale header - applies encoding transformation
buildLocaleHeader :: Text -> BS.ByteString
buildLocaleHeader loc =
  let encoded = TE.encodeUtf8 loc
      -- Allow through printable ASCII and high bytes (UTF-8 continuations)
      sanitized = BS.filter (\w -> w >= 0x20 || w >= 0x80) encoded
  in sanitized

-- | Simulate enriching a profile with external data
enrichProfile :: UserProfile -> IO UserProfile
enrichProfile p = return p

-- | Main application handler
app :: SessionStore -> Application
app store req respond = do
  let path = pathInfo req
  case path of
    ["api", "report"] -> handleReport store req respond
    ["api", "register"] -> handleRegister store req respond
    _ -> respond $ responseLBS status404 [] "Not found"

handleRegister :: SessionStore -> Application
handleRegister store req respond = do
  body <- strictRequestBody req
  case decode body of
    Nothing -> respond $ responseLBS status400 [] "Invalid JSON"
    Just profile -> do
      let sid = T.pack $ show (LBS.length body) <> "_session"
      modifyMVar_ store (return . Map.insert sid profile)
      respond $ responseLBS status200
        [(hContentType, "application/json")]
        (encode $ Map.fromList [("session_id" :: Text, sid)])

handleReport :: SessionStore -> Application
handleReport store req respond = do
  let headers = requestHeaders req
      mSession = lookup "X-Session-Id" headers
  case mSession of
    Nothing -> respond $ responseLBS status401 [] "No session"
    Just sid -> do
      let sessionText = TE.decodeUtf8 sid
      respHeaders <- buildResponseHeaders store sessionText
      respond $ responseLBS status200 respHeaders "PDF_CONTENT_HERE"

main :: IO ()
main = do
  store <- newMVar Map.empty
  putStrLn "Starting server on port 8080"
  run 8080 (app store)
